layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Carnivore dental morphology side-profile
features: Extreme close-up of a friendly red clay dinosaur snout
Mouth is closed in a 'crocodile smile' where the upper teeth overlap the lower jaw
Visible white clay teeth are conical and smooth with blunt, safe tips
A single, tiny specular glint of light on one tooth for a playful effect
Tactile clay surface with gentle, soft skin folds along the mouth line
layer_3_action.action: A side-profile close-up focusing strictly on the interlocking teeth and the texture of the snout. The dinosaur is 'smiling' with a closed mouth, highlighting the distinct dental arrangement. The lighting is soft and warm, casting gentle shadows that emphasize the 3D clay shapes. The background is a soft-focus jungle green. No text.
